fields.label: Species
fields.description: Select the organism from which the sample was obtained. Use the species-level taxonomy entry whenever possible; the submitted value should correspond to an NCBI Taxonomy term.

fields.label: Tissue
fields.description: Specify the tissue or anatomical structure from which the sample was collected. Select the most specific tissue term available from the Uberon for animals and PlantOntology for plants.

fields.label: Strain
fields.description: Enter the strain the organism if known. Use the designation commonly reported in publications or vendor documentation.

fields.label: Disease
fields.description: Specify any disease or pathological condition associated with the organism or sample source. Add multiple entries if more than one disease is relevant.

fields.label: Cellular Component
fields.description: Indicate the cellular location from which glycans or glycoproteins were isolated or are known to reside. Select the most appropriate Gene Ontology cellular component term.

fields.label: Developmental Stage
fields.description: Describe the developmental, growth, or life-cycle stage of the organism at the time of sampling. Use a clear and commonly accepted stage description.

fields.label: Radiation
fields.description: Describe any exposure of the sample or organism to ionizing or non-ionizing radiation before collection. Include radiation type and dose when available.

fields.label: Chemical
fields.description: List chemicals or media additives to which the sample was exposed prior to collection. Include concentration and treatment duration when known.
fields.example: Additional 25 mM glucose added to culture media

fields.label: Drug
fields.description: Record any drug treatment administered to the organism, tissue, or cells before sample collection. Include the drug name and, if available, concentration or dosage.
